title: Training-Free Continual Learning for Multimodal Forecasting via Prompt Evolution

claim.summary: The work evolves a plain-text guidance block for a frozen LLM forecaster through GEPA-style reflection on forecast-versus-realized traces, parent gating and Pareto selection, under knowledge-cutoff contamination control, and optionally compiles the guidance into code that calls a TSFM.

modules.name: Outcome-gated forecasting guidance evolution
modules.scope_reason: The reflector rewrites forecasting guidance from forecast-versus-realized traces and per-window MASE, and children are gated and Pareto-selected on forecast error.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "2. Reflect. The reflector reads"

modules.name: Cutoff-postdating tiers with untouched monitor
modules.scope_reason: Windows are admitted by their origin relative to each model's knowledge cutoff and consumed at separate rates; this availability-time control does not depend on the forecast output and applies to other LLM tasks on time-indexed data.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "Cross-model experiments with Claude Opus"

modules.name: Guidance-to-code compilation with TSFM tool
modules.scope_reason: Each guidance candidate is compiled into a forecast(window) function that may call TabPFN-TS, and a final LLM pass issues the forecast.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; passage beginning "(1) A coding LLM (Claude"
